name: John Yuda
tagline: Senior Product Manager & Digital Government Leader

employers.name: Technology Transformation Services, General Services Administration

highlights: PLACEHOLDER — John is still deciding what this entry should say.

Led strategy and development for critical federal government infrastructure — cloud.gov pages allows federal agencies to quickly and efficiently stand up websites that are 508 and security compliant out of the box.
Managed relationships with Secretary of State and State Election Director offices in all 50 states and 5 territories, as well as various federal and non-governmental stakeholders.
Expanded vote.gov language support from 2 to 20 languages.
Led digitization of the federal voter registration form and worked with federal agencies and states to identify opportunities for voter registration via data sharing.
Spearheaded project to pilot identity verification of public citizens using only data the government already holds.
Managed relationships between federal agencies and other stakeholders.
Led effort to re-imagine USA.gov for the 21st century, identifying opportunities to reduce administrative burden via information sharing between agencies.
Led myUSCIS modernization effort with USCIS, with a heavy focus on how the public was asked to share information when seeking benefits or immigration status.
Helped lead establishment of design and product management practices at 18F.
Led design and user research on agency priorities including regulatory changes, consumer relationships with debt and the government, and more.
Led projects modernizing presentation of agency regulations and collection of public comment.

testimonial.quote: John validated the confidence and trust we placed in him when we gave him 18F's most high-profile and difficult assignment: leading our team at USCIS. That project team has delivered excellence repeatedly, and has planted the seeds of methodological change.
